name: Dulwich College (Singapore)
summary: British independent school model in Bukit Batok with IGCSEs and IB Diploma — verify Mandarin as immersion vs optional language by year group.
body: Dulwich Singapore brings a UK independent-school culture to the west, with strong performing arts and academic pathways through IGCSE and IB. Forum school-choice threads often name Dulwich when families want British structure plus some Mandarin exposure — but optional language slots are not bilingual immersion. Ask admissions for weekly Mandarin hours by year and whether intensity continues past junior school. Bukit Batok geography pairs with west-side housing; peak CBD reverse-commute is a separate adult problem from the child bus. Tour early and price the full fee stack including bus.
waitlistNotes: Year-group dependent; early registration recommended. Confirm Mandarin pathway intensity by year in writing.
